what: DIAGNOSTIC: shipped 6,003-fragment library vs the unused 22,007-fragment fragment_db_large.npz, retrieval only (BLOSUM top-500), scored against native CA as an oracle label. No distogram, filter, projection or AMBER.
verdict: NEGATIVE. A 3.21x larger fragment library from the same corpus does not move the pool mean (the quantity the S10-1 law says governs the answer), moves the retrieval ceiling by 0.049 A, and leaves universe best UNCHANGED on half the targets. The fragment library is structurally SATURATED at 9-16 residues. Coverage is not the constraint.
